question: What is the meaning of environmental building performance in relation to sustainability performance, certificates, performance statements?
description: Environmental building performance refers to the assessment and evaluation of the environmental impact of building materials and products, aiming to promote sustainable and circular practices, minimize environmental impact, and ensure comfortable and healthy living spaces. It is closely related to sustainability performance, as it involves measuring and improving the environmental aspects of buildings. This performance is often certified and reported through performance statements, which provide transparent and verifiable information about the environmental impact of building materials and products. These statements are essential for businesses, consumers, and stakeholders to make informed decisions and promote sustainable construction practices.
